# `revision.withdraw`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/revision.withdraw.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`revision.withdraw` (`WithdrawRevision`): withdraws a released revision (doc 15 §5.10, FR-REV-009; WP-S1.18 D5).
The CLI's `ew revision withdraw <label> --reason <text>` and the GUI's Revision ▸ Withdraw are WP-S1.18 parts 3
and 5.

Adds a withdrawal record `Revision {label, state: withdrawn, withdraws: <revision>, reason}` with the ID
`v5(revision, "withdrawal")` and the label of the revision it withdraws (EW-INV-017 lets a withdrawal record
repeat it); the withdrawn revision stays byte for byte as it was (EW-INV-020), and so does its archive. Rejected:
a revision that does not exist, or that is not released (open, a withdrawal record, a state of a newer format;
at `/revision`); a revision withdrawn already; an empty reason or one that is only white space (at `/reason`).
**Exposure `HumanOnly`** (doc 15 §5.10): command logs, scripts, MCP and plugins get `CmdError::Exposure`.
Interactive; undoable as one step. Outcome: the withdrawal record.

## Types

### CmdMlText

Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags in ascending order with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: map of string (at least 1 character(s)) (at least 1 propert(ies))

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).

Exposure class `human_only`: [doc 17 §2.3](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#23-origins-and-exposure-classes) says whether a command log may run it.
